2026-07-29 堀再監査(v9.9.41): 旧dom=70→新dom=50、旧moatW=70→新moatW=70(不変)。旧70は根拠欄そのものが空だった(evidence.dom 不在)。10-KのCompetition節は自ら『fragmented profile of the regional markets』『numerous smaller competitors』『low cost imports』と述べており、規約3の残余適用で50。『world's largest manufacturer』は規約4により証拠に採らない。moatWはセグメント実数・製品別実数・顧客集中文言を再確認して70を維持。dom/moatW/_meta 以外は不変。
2026-07-29 roiic機械算出（新設・v9.9.46）: 3年窓=12.7 / 5年窓=26.5。空欄のままだと門は roiicNA として F6=58 の定数を返し、『再投資率×ROIIC』も複利停止キルも一度も作動しない状態だった

evidence.moatW: セグメント別売上(FY2025・千USD): Americas Welding 2,723,561=64.3% / International Welding 930,865=22.0% / The Harris Products Group 578,577=13.7%、合計4,233,003。前二者は同一のアーク溶接事業の地域分割であり『地域別セグメントは独立した堀ではない』(v9.9.41)により1本。Harris(切断・ろう付・ガス機器)は13.7%で15%閾値未達。→ 独立した堀は1本。その内部の分散を製品別開示(Disaggregation of Revenue)で確認: Consumables 2,283,101=53.9% / Equipment 1,079,603=25.5% / Automation 870,299=20.6% ＝ 最大製品ライン53.9%(<70%)。用途は general fabrication / energy / heavy industries / automotive and transportation / structural の5大エンドマーケットに分散。顧客集中は10-K『The Company is not dependent on a single customer or a few customers and **no individual customer currently accounts for more than ten percent of total Net sales**』。→ 単一事業だが用途・顧客・地域が分散(最大顧客<10% かつ 最大製品<70%) = moatW 70(据置)。出典: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/59527/000005952726000006/leco-20251231x10k.htm
evidence.dom: 自社シェア%: **原本(FY2025 10-K)に開示なし**／上位N社合計%: 同じく開示なし。提出書類自身が市場をfragmentedと明言しているため残余の刻み50で確定(v9.9.41規約3)。原文: 『Commercial conditions in the arc welding, cutting and automation/system integration industries are highly competitive due to the **fragmented profile of the regional markets**. The Company believes it is the world's largest manufacturer of arc welding solutions and has relatively few global broad-line competitors worldwide, but **numerous smaller competitors in specific geographic markets**.』(Item 1 Competition)。『We operate in a highly competitive global environment and compete in each of our businesses with other broad-line manufacturers and numerous smaller competitors specializing in particular products』『the arc welding industry in the United States and other developed countries has been subject to increased levels of **foreign competition as low cost imports have become more readily available**』『in certain markets of the world, **distributors manufacture and sell arc welding products**』(Item 1A)。※『the world's largest manufacturer of arc welding solutions』『the leader in the arc welding industry』は**順位の自称でありどの刻みの証拠にもならない**(v9.9.41規約4)。出典: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/59527/000005952726000006/leco-20251231x10k.htm
